definitions.explanation: A problem or imperfection in something that prevents it from working properly.

examples.japanese: {製品|せいひん}の{欠陥|けっかん}
{欠陥|けっかん}{商品|しょうひん}
{設計|せっけい}に{欠陥|けっかん}がある。
examples.english: There is a flaw in the design.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}には{重大|じゅうだい}な{欠陥|けっかん}が{見|み}つかり、メーカーは{全国|ぜんこく}でリコールを{実施|じっし}した。
examples.english: A serious defect was found in this car, and the manufacturer implemented a nationwide recall.

notes:
{欠陥|けっかん} refers to defects or flaws.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {欠陥|けっかん}{商品|しょうひん} (defective product)
- {欠陥|けっかん}{住宅|じゅうたく} (defective housing)
- {欠陥|けっかん}{車|しゃ} (defective car)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {欠陥|けっかん}: defect (serious, systemic)
- {欠点|けってん}: shortcoming (personal or minor)
- {不良|ふりょう}: defective (quality control term)
